answer: Attested tenure clears a rising bar before a harbor records a new identity: the kth identity under one operator must alone accrue more attested epochs than the harbor's mirror shows for all earlier identities. That mirror carries the delta of prior tenures, and each admission adds its own tenure to the delta, so a tenth identity needs 512 attested epochs while a first needs one; parallel clones cannot share the bar because each must pass the whole prior delta with its own work.
